text:
sarah-partners: Quick sync — we're prepping the three-cloud marketplace listings (AWS / GCP / Azure). Need alignment on: IAM roles (publisher vs vendor), KMS key ownership (customer-managed vs marketplace), and branding assets (logo sizes, screenshots). Who owns each artifact and can confirm requirements?

tim-legal: @sarah-partners we own the legal artifacts (EULA, contract language, privacy notice). KMS: for private deployments we require customer-managed keys; for public marketplace entry we can accept marketplace-managed keys but prefer customer KMS when PII is involved. I'll post specific wording. :memo:

ivy-product: Product side: packaging should include trial tier + 30-day seat model and SKU metadata for trial vs paid. We need hero image (1600x600), 2 screenshots (1200x800), short bullet list (max 6), and feature icons. I'll upload assets to Drive and add the SKU CSV.

jonas-eng: For AWS/GCP we need two IAM roles: publisher-invoke (used by marketplace to run verification/webhooks) and publisher-deploy (used for image/AMI publish). Draft trust policy example below for AWS sts assume role: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Service": "marketplace.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Also for GCP we need a service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and marketplace-specific IAM bindings. I'll add terraform snippets to infra/marketplace.

lisa-ops: Ops note: Azure requires a service principal with Contributor on the Resource Group + KeyVault access policy for wrapping keys. Network: marketplace publish must be able to reach our publish endpoint on port 443; if customer wants IP allowlist we need to share IP ranges.

sarah-partners: Tim — can you confirm the KMS stance & any required contract language by EOD? Ivy — upload hero + screenshots by EOD tomorrow so we can start artifact validation. Jonas — please push IAM / terraform templates to the infra repo path infra/marketplace/publisher-roles and add a README for publishers.

tim-legal: Will confirm KMS clause. Quick Q: do we localize EULAs? For EU/CA launches we should prepare EN/FR/DE at minimum. Do we want JP/KO for APAC pilot?

sarah-partners: For launch we'll do EN/FR/DE. APAC later — mark localization as phased.

marketplace-bot: Checklist created: https://internal.redwood/integrations/marketplace-checklist. Steps: 1) IAM templates in repo, 2) KMS policy confirmed, 3) Assets uploaded, 4) EULA localized, 5) SKU mapping CSV, 6) test publish to staging.

jonas-eng: Pushed IAM templates + example terraform to branch feature/marketplace-onboard. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/marketplace/compare/feature/marketplace-onboard. Added example trust policy and notes about sequence length limits for AMIs.

ivy-product: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-assets (hero.svg, hero.png, screenshot-1.png, screenshot-2.png). Added alt text and captions. Also attached sample SKU CSV.

lisa-ops: I'll run a quick validation script against the uploaded assets and the terraform templates tomorrow morning and block time with infra for a 30m handoff at 10:30 PT.

sarah-partners: I'll assemble a short release plan and send a calendar invite for the cross-functional handoff. Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers drop them here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
